command.summary: Create a storage account. The SKU of the storage account defaults to 'Standard_RAGRS'.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The storage account name.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --access-tier
parameters.help: Required for storage accounts where kind = BlobStorage. The access tier is used for billing. The "Premium" access tier is the default value for premium block blobs storage account type and it cannot be changed for the premium block blobs storage account type.

parameters.name: --allow-blob-public-access
parameters.help: Allow or disallow public access to all blobs or containers in the storage account. If not specified, the default value is false for new accounts to follow best security practices. When true, containers in the account may be configured for public access. Note that setting this property to true does not enable anonymous access to any data in the account. The additional step of configuring the public access setting for a container is required to enable anonymous access.

parameters.name: --allow-cross-tenant-replication
parameters.help: Allow or disallow cross AAD tenant object replication. Set this property to true for new or existing accounts only if object replication policies will involve storage accounts in different AAD tenants. If not specified, the default value is false for new accounts to follow best security practices.

parameters.name: --allow-shared-key-access
parameters.help: Indicate whether the storage account permits requests to be authorized with the account access key via Shared Key. If false, then all requests, including shared access signatures, must be authorized with Azure Active Directory (Azure AD). The default value is null, which is equivalent to true.

parameters.name: --allowed-copy-scope
parameters.help: Restrict copy to and from Storage Accounts within an AAD tenant or with Private Links to the same VNet.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Generate and assign a new Storage Account Identity for this storage account for use with key management services like Azure KeyVault.

parameters.name: --blob-geo-sla
parameters.help: Indicates whether Blob Geo Priority Replication is enabled for the storage account.

parameters.name: --custom-domain
parameters.help: User domain assigned to the storage account. Name is the CNAME source.

parameters.name: --dns-endpoint-type
parameters.help: Allow you to specify the type of endpoint. Set this to AzureDNSZone to create a large number of accounts in a single subscription, which creates accounts in an Azure DNS Zone and the endpoint URL will have an alphanumeric DNS Zone identifier.

parameters.name: --edge-zone
parameters.help: The name of edge zone.

parameters.name: --enable-hierarchical-namespace
parameters.help: Allow the blob service to exhibit filesystem semantics. This property can be enabled only when storage account kind is StorageV2.

parameters.name: --enable-large-file-share
parameters.help: Enable the capability to support large file shares with more than 5 TiB capacity for storage account.Once the property is enabled, the feature cannot be disabled. Currently only supported for LRS and ZRS replication types, hence account conversions to geo-redundant accounts would not be possible. For more information, please refer to https://go.microsoft. com/fwlink/?linkid=2086047.

parameters.name: --enable-local-user
parameters.help: Enable local user features.

parameters.name: --enable-nfs-v3
parameters.help: NFS 3.0 protocol support enabled if sets to true.

parameters.name: --enable-sftp
parameters.help: Enable Secure File Transfer Protocol.

parameters.name: --encryption-key-type-for-queue
parameters.help: Set the encryption key type for Queue service. "Account": Queue will be encrypted with account-scoped encryption key. "Service": Queue will always be encrypted with service- scoped keys. Currently the default encryption key type is "Service".

parameters.name: --encryption-key-type-for-table
parameters.help: Set the encryption key type for Table service. "Account": Table will be encrypted with account-scoped encryption key. "Service": Table will always be encrypted with service- scoped keys. Currently the default encryption key type is "Service".

parameters.name: --encryption-services
parameters.help: Specifies which service(s) to encrypt.

parameters.name: --https-only
parameters.help: Allow https traffic only to storage service if set to true. The default value is true.

parameters.name: --key-exp-days
parameters.help: Expiration period in days of the Key Policy assigned to the storage account. WARNING: Argument '--key-expiration-period-in-days' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --kind
parameters.help: Indicate the type of storage account.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --min-tls-version
parameters.help: The minimum TLS version to be permitted on requests to storage. TLS1_3 is not yet supported. Microsoft recommends setting MinimumTlsVersion to TLS1_2.

parameters.name: --public-network-access
parameters.help: Enable or disable public network access to the storage account.

parameters.name: --require-infrastructure-encryption
parameters.help: A boolean indicating whether or not the service applies a secondary layer of encryption with platform managed keys for data at rest.

parameters.name: --sas-exp
parameters.help: Expiration period of the SAS Policy assigned to the storage account, DD.HH:MM:SS.

parameters.name: --sas-exp-action
parameters.help: The action to be performed when --sas-expiration-period is violated. The 'Log' action can be used for audit purposes and the 'Block' action can be used to block and deny the usage of SAS tokens that do not adhere to the sas policy expiration period. The default action is 'Log'.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: The storage account SKU.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --zone-placement-policy
parameters.help: The availability zone pinning policy for the storage account.

parameters.name: --zones
parameters.help: Describes the available zones for the product where storage account resource can be created.

parameters.name: --allow-append
parameters.help: This property can only be changed for disabled and unlocked time-based retention policies. When enabled, new blocks can be written to an append blob while maintaining immutability protection and compliance. Only new blocks can be added and any existing blocks cannot be modified or deleted.

parameters.name: --enable-alw
parameters.help: The account level immutability property. The property is immutable and can only be set to true at the account creation time. When set to true, it enables object level immutability for all the containers in the account by default.

parameters.name: --immutability-period
parameters.help: The immutability period for the blobs in the container since the policy creation, in days.

parameters.name: --immutability-state
parameters.help: Defines the mode of the policy. Disabled state disables the policy, Unlocked state allows increase and decrease of immutability retention time and also allows toggling allow- protected-append-write property, Locked state only allows the increase of the immutability retention time. A policy can only be created in a Disabled or Unlocked state and can be toggled between the two states. Only a policy in an Unlocked state can transition to a Locked state which cannot be reverted.

parameters.name: --account-type
parameters.help: Specify the Active Directory account type for Azure Storage.

parameters.name: --azure-storage-sid
parameters.help: Specify the security identifier (SID) for Azure Storage. Required when --enable-files-adds is set to True.

parameters.name: --domain-guid
parameters.help: Specify the domain GUID. Required when --enable-files-adds is set to True.

parameters.name: --domain-name
parameters.help: Specify the primary domain that the AD DNS server is authoritative for. Required when --enable-files-adds is set to True.

parameters.name: --domain-sid
parameters.help: Specify the security identifier (SID). Required when --enable-files- adds is set to True.

parameters.name: --forest-name
parameters.help: Specify the Active Directory forest to get. Required when --enable-files- adds is set to True.

parameters.name: --net-bios-domain-name
parameters.help: Specify the NetBIOS domain name. Required when --enable-files-adds is set to True.

parameters.name: --sam-account-name
parameters.help: Specify the Active Directory SAMAccountName for Azure Storage.

parameters.name: --default-share-permission
parameters.group: Azure Files Identity Based Authentication Arguments
parameters.help: Default share permission for users using Kerberos authentication if RBAC role is not assigned.

parameters.name: --enable-files-aadds
parameters.group: Azure Files Identity Based Authentication Arguments
parameters.help: Enable Azure Active Directory Domain Services authentication for Azure Files.

parameters.name: --enable-files-aadkerb
parameters.group: Azure Files Identity Based Authentication Arguments
parameters.help: Enable Azure Files Active Directory Domain Service Kerberos Authentication for the storage account.

parameters.name: --enable-files-adds
parameters.group: Azure Files Identity Based Authentication Arguments
parameters.help: Enable Azure Files Active Directory Domain Service Authentication for storage account. When --enable-files- adds is set to true, Azure Active Directory Properties arguments must be provided.

parameters.name: --enable-smb-oauth
parameters.group: Azure Files Identity Based Authentication Arguments
parameters.help: Specifies if managed identities can access SMB shares using OAuth. The default interpretation is false for this property.

parameters.name: --encryption-key-name
parameters.help: The name of the KeyVault key.

parameters.name: --encryption-key-source
parameters.help: The default encryption key source.

parameters.name: --encryption-key-vault
parameters.help: The Uri of the KeyVault.

parameters.name: --encryption-key-version
parameters.help: The version of the KeyVault key to use, which will opt out of implicit key rotation. Please use "" to opt in key auto-rotation again.

parameters.name: --key-vault-federated-client-id
parameters.help: ClientId of the multi-tenant application to be used in conjunction with the user-assigned identity for cross-tenant customer-managed-keys server-side encryption on the storage account.

parameters.name: --key-vault-user-identity-id
parameters.help: Resource identifier of the UserAssigned identity to be associated with server-side encryption on the storage account.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --publish-ipv6-endpoint
parameters.help: A boolean flag which indicates whether IPv6 storage endpoints are to be published. WARNING: Argument '--publish-ipv6-endpoint' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --identity-type
parameters.help: The identity type.

parameters.name: --user-identity-id
parameters.help: The key is the ARM resource identifier of the identity. Only 1 User Assigned identity is permitted here.

parameters.name: --action
parameters.help: The action of virtual network rule. Possible value is Allow.

parameters.name: --bypass
parameters.help: Bypass traffic for space-separated uses.

parameters.name: --default-action
parameters.help: Default action to apply when no rule matches.

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: Name or ID of subnet. If name is supplied, `--vnet-name` must be supplied.

parameters.name: --vnet-name
parameters.help: Name of a virtual network.

parameters.name: --publish-internet-endpoints
parameters.help: A boolean flag which indicates whether internet routing storage endpoints are to be published.

parameters.name: --publish-microsoft-endpoints
parameters.help: A boolean flag which indicates whether microsoft routing storage endpoints are to be published.

parameters.name: --routing-choice
parameters.help: Routing Choice defines the kind of network routing opted by the user.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
